add.label: STATUTE

comment: Extended the chain Art. 72 Abs. 2 lit. a, Art. 74 Abs. 2 lit. c und Art. 75 Abs. 1 BGG (Art. 19 SchKG before it is its own span). Added one BGE list item. Left unlabelled: 'Art. 6 der Verordnung vom 5. Juni 1996 ... (VFRR; SR 281.31)', because the abbreviation follows the full law name, a date and a bracket. The later short form Art. 6 VFRR is labelled.
